title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: App Blocks turn requests into interactive apps in the conversation
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing context and admin path are supported, and searches did not find App Blocks-specific documentation. Qualify the blocking guidance because Microsoft Learn pages disagree about whether Integrated Apps blocking covers Teams and can be scoped to users or groups.

claims.claim: Blocking the Copilot app is a broad Copilot Chat control rather than an App Blocks-only control.
claims.quote: Users blocked through Integrated Apps see the *Copilot Chat was turned off for your organization* experience when opening Copilot Chat in the Copilot app.

claims.claim: Blocking Copilot through Integrated Apps is a tenant-wide control.
claims.quote: Blocking Copilot through Integrated Apps is a tenant-wide control

claims.claim: According to Manage Copilot Chat, Integrated Apps blocking can be scoped to specific users or groups, including licensed users.
claims.quote: is a tenant-wide control that you can scope to specific users or groups, including licensed users.
claims.fix: After that sentence add: 'The general Integrated Apps reference instead says that Block app blocks the app for all users in the organization.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/admin/manage/teams-apps-work-on-outlook-and-m365#how-to-block-an-app, which states: 'When you choose to block an app, it is blocked for all users in your organization.'

claims.claim: Integrated Apps blocking blocks Copilot in the Microsoft Copilot app.
claims.quote: This setting blocks Copilot in the Microsoft Copilot app, Teams, Outlook, and Copilot Chat on the web for all users.

claims.claim: Integrated Apps blocking blocks Copilot in Teams.
claims.quote: This setting blocks Copilot in the Microsoft Copilot app, Teams, Outlook, and Copilot Chat on the web for all users.
claims.fix: Replace the sentence beginning 'It blocks Copilot' with: 'Manage Copilot Chat says this setting blocks Copilot in the Microsoft Copilot app, Teams, Outlook and Copilot Chat on the web. The general Integrated Apps reference differs: it says the app is blocked only in the Microsoft Copilot application and Outlook, while Teams continues to honor Teams admin center settings.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/manage-copilot-chat and https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/admin/manage/teams-apps-work-on-outlook-and-m365#how-to-block-an-app.
